reference.title: Report JSON
reference.shortdesc: Every run writes report/report.json and an HTML page made from it. These are its top-level fields.

property.propdesc: Fail if any topic failed a check or a link is broken.
Counts of topics passed, fixed, sent for review and failed, and the builds compared.
Each success metric with its target, measured value and how it was measured.
Each topic's status, its result for each check, a note and every difference.
Source elements with no rule, each sent to a writer.
Issues found in the source that the migration kept as they were.
For a run with the agent: the model, the topics fixed and the topics sent for review.
